name: OnBoard
description: OnBoard is a board governance platform for meetings, agendas, board books, documents, minutes, tasks, approvals and voting, surveys, questionnaires, assessments, messaging, annotations, committees, and governance records.
agentUseSummary: OnBoard documents native Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, DocuSign, SAML SSO, calendar, and storage integrations inside its product, but no distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract. Relay therefore mounts no connection or tools.

blocked.label: Connect an OnBoard organization
blocked.description: OnBoard does not publish a distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract for third-party access to an organization.

blocked.label: Read OnBoard data
blocked.description: Meetings, agendas, books, documents, minutes, tasks, votes, approvals, surveys, questionnaires, assessments, messages, annotations, committees, users, reports, and audit data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change OnBoard
blocked.description: Meeting preparation, invitations, publishing, uploads, minutes, tasks, voting, approvals, surveys, permissions, user administration, exports, and every mutation remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without a reviewed, distributable OnBoard customer API or hosted MCP contract.

providerSetup.blocker: OnBoard's public first-party materials document product-native integrations with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, DocuSign, SAML identity providers, calendars, and storage services. The reviewed public surface does not publish a distributable external customer authorization method, tenant or API origin, least-privilege scope model for automation, endpoint or tool schema, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect behavior, or non-production contract. OnBoard also contains highly sensitive governance records governed by granular role, meeting, committee, and document permissions, so browser or private-endpoint automation is not an acceptable fallback.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request OnBoard login credentials or show Connect, and do not automate its web or mobile clients. Reconsider OnBoard only after OnBoard publishes or contractually supplies a distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract with exact tenant and server origins, authentication, least-privilege permissions, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhook behavior, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access.

evidence.supports: OnBoard's current integration page documents Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, DocuSign, and SAML SSO as embedded product integrations governed by OnBoard permissions and audit logging; it does not describe an external customer API.

OnBoard documents agenda and book building, meeting minutes, committee and task management, document collaboration, and virtual meetings as product workflows whose records Relay must leave unavailable without an authorization contract.

OnBoard documents role-based and per-document permissions, governed files tied to meetings, agendas, and committees, version history, audit trails, and live co-authoring, demonstrating a sensitive permission model that cannot be inferred for automation.

OnBoard documents granular permissions, SSO and MFA, remote wipe, exportable activity logs, encryption, and access tracking across meetings and files, supporting a critical risk classification and fail-closed handling.

OnBoard's current package page lists agendas and books, annotations, user and group permissions, calendars, minutes, tasks, voting and approvals, surveys, eSignatures, SSO, questionnaires, assessments, and skills tracking, while describing only native Office 365, DocuSign, Teams, and Zoom integrations.

Passageways' current privacy policy covers the OnBoard web and mobile platform, enterprise-customer content, profiles, meeting content, AI prompts and outputs, usage and device data, and international processing, reinforcing the need not to infer undocumented access.
